recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-10762. If PA wants to review old Dutch role-code OID occurrences in non-Practitioner examples, handle that as a separate issue because it is outside this Jira request and implementation trail.
issue_request: FHIR-10762 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request reporting that Practitioner examples f001/f005 used urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.15.111 for role/specialty codings and should be corrected when those roles migrated to PractitionerRole.
initial_application: Git commit 552e17520a123a9c027792aab6cf875b40f76e07 previously applied FHIR-10762 by changing the active PractitionerRole general example bundle from the old AssignedRoleType OID to SNOMED CT role/specialty codings and by fixing the PractitionerRole examples list entry to reference the bundle.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Practitioner and PractitionerRole. Current f001/f005 Practitioner examples contain demographics/identifiers but no role or specialty codings, while their migrated PractitionerRole entries use SNOMED CT. Later terminology QA commit 6a8c26405c4a1430c7817e211d2f84acc57f9105 corrected SNOMED display strings without reintroducing the old system. Jira/community searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed; the no-change commit documents that the current build-scope source already satisfies the issue.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive PA issue reporting that Practitioner examples f001/f005 used the wrong role/specialty coding system.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final issue scope: correct the Practitioner example role/specialty codings, considering their PractitionerRole migration.

evidence_items.summary: The reporter quoted the old Practitioner example coding with urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.15.111, and Grahame Grieve replied that the example had the wrong system and should get a tracker.
evidence_items.learned: The community origin confirms the old OID problem and aligns with the Jira request.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-10762 implementation changed PractitionerRole examples from the old AssignedRoleType OID to SNOMED CT codings and fixed the examples list bundle reference.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was already applied to the active migrated PractitionerRole examples.

evidence_items.summary: Practitioner and PractitionerRole are active resources; the current f005-0 and f001-0 PractitionerRole examples use http://snomed.info/sct for role and specialty codings.
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope source already conveys the corrected coding system for the examples implicated by the issue.

evidence_items.summary: Later QA changed the SNOMED display strings in PractitionerRole examples to match the CodeSystem.
evidence_items.learned: Subsequent history refined the applied fix and did not reintroduce the old OID.

evidence_items.locator: Current source and community searches for remaining FHIR-10762 conflict
evidence_items.command: rg -n 'urn:oid:2\.16\.840\.1\.113883\.2\.4\.15\.111|AssignedRoleType' source/practitioner source/practitionerrole; bun run jira:search fts '"2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.15.111" PractitionerRole' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-10762
evidence_items.summary: No old OID/AssignedRoleType occurrences remain under source/practitioner or source/practitionerrole; the Jira search returned only FHIR-10762; Confluence had no FHIR-10762 references.
evidence_items.learned: No in-scope source remnant or conflicting later decision was found.
